interiorElementsSweep.domain: the reused lattice-identity 80-case cross (4 skeletons x 4 regions x 5 seeds)

keplerPeriodMs.note: radius equal to KeplerBaseRadius — ratio 1, the law's own reference point
radius zero — a degenerate orbit; ratio 0, sqrt 0, seconds 0, clamped to the 1ms floor (well-behaved: no NaN)
the smallest radius generation ever actually places a star-parented body at (idx 0)
a radius far below anything generation produces
a radius far above anything generation produces, well short of the seconds*1000 overflow-to-+Inf threshold (~1e203)

keplerPeriodMsSweep.note: a non-negative radius drawn from [0, 1e9] — the full range of radii a physical distance can take, well beyond anything generation produces, EXCLUDING radius < 0 (a reported, pre-existing cross-build-target divergence via NaN->int64 conversion; see the family's own doc comment above handKeplerPeriodMs)
keplerPeriodMsSweep.drawMapping: u = float64(word >> 11) * 0x1p-53; float axis = lo + float64(u*(hi-lo)); int axis = lo + int64(float64(u*float64(hi-lo+1))), clamped to hi; a string axis draws an int index into a named, finite choice list
keplerPeriodMsSweep.serialization: integers in decimal, floats as strconv.FormatFloat(v, 'b', -1, 64), strings verbatim, components joined by ','

gateOrbit.note: a zero horizontal projection resolves to the named default phase index
elevation (Z, the coordinate's third component) is dropped — only X/Y (the horizontal plane) resolves the bearing
an exact tie (straight along the table's index-0 direction) resolves to the documented lower index

gateOrbitSweep.note: two independently drawn galaxy.Coords (from, to) and an extent, all from generous boxes; the output is the derived orbit's parentId/radius/periodMs/phase/inclination/node
gateOrbitSweep.drawMapping: u = float64(word >> 11) * 0x1p-53; float axis = lo + float64(u*(hi-lo)); int axis = lo + int64(float64(u*float64(hi-lo+1))), clamped to hi; a string axis draws an int index into a named, finite choice list
gateOrbitSweep.serialization: integers in decimal, floats as strconv.FormatFloat(v, 'b', -1, 64), strings verbatim, components joined by ','

stationOrbit.note: an empty skeleton falls back to a star-parented orbit at the configured fallback radius (unreachable in production today — MinBodies=1 — but a named branch)
a single-body skeleton — the mix64-derived parent index is always 0
a gas-giant parent draws the largest type-keyed size ceiling
a multi-body skeleton exercises the mix64-derived parent selection
a different system id with the same galaxy seed and skeleton selects independently — SystemSeed mixes the id into the hash

stationOrbitSweep.note: a galaxy seed, a synthetic system id (one of 12), and a skeleton of 1-8 independently drawn galaxy.BodyType values; the output is the derived station orbit's parentId/radius/periodMs/phase/inclination/node
stationOrbitSweep.drawMapping: u = float64(word >> 11) * 0x1p-53; float axis = lo + float64(u*(hi-lo)); int axis = lo + int64(float64(u*float64(hi-lo+1))), clamped to hi; a string axis draws an int index into a named, finite choice list

draws.name: systemId
draws.note: one of 12 synthetic ids sys-0..sys-11, selected by an int draw

draws.name: bodyTypes[i]
draws.note: each of bodyCount draws one of the 6 galaxy.BodyType values, in order

stationOrbitSweep.serialization: integers in decimal, floats as strconv.FormatFloat(v, 'b', -1, 64), strings verbatim, components joined by ','
